notes.title: Call the Tune - 1.1.8 Update!
notes.content:
- Minor bug fixes
- Typo and spelling mistake corrections 
- Story polishing
- A full CG gallery
- A new graphic asset has been added to one of the routes
-[b] Rephrasing the inventory information:[/b] You can view items at any time by clicking on the top left icon. Click on an item to use it.
- Achievements

notes.title: Achievements Added to Call the Tune
notes.content:
We are glad to announce that Steam Achievements are now available for Call the Tune!

The character cards are popping out of the game to celebrate your hard work and dedication.

And don’t worry — if you’ve already completed an objective tied to a card before this update, the corresponding achievement will be automatically added to your account.
